title: Add audit tamper-evidence reports
summary: Add a lightweight tamper-evidence layer for the audit log: hash-chain sidecar entries for JSONL audit events, deterministic verification reports, operator-facing CLI/HTTP/IPC surfaces, and retention documentation.
expectedFailureModes: Existing audit readers break when a chain sidecar is present.
Purging old audit events leaves stale hash-chain anchors that make a valid retained log look corrupt.
The integrity report claims cryptographic publication or non-repudiation before public signing and transparency-log policy exist.
A non-operator peer can inspect global audit integrity metadata across peers.
verification: cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd audit_integrity --locked
cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenant audit --locked
humanEscalation: Approval before public signing keys, transparency-log publication, or changing audit retention defaults
nextAction: Integrated locally; next audit hardening slice should define public root signing, transparency publication, and immutable retention policy before release claims.
